messages:
Maria: Hey team — onboarding solace-13B to s3://redwood-models/solace/13b/v1. Quick checklist: weights uploaded, tokenizer files present, model_config.json staged. Two things I hit: 1) tokenizer quirk — tokenizer.json shows BOS token id = 1 but training seemed to use no explicit BOS which causes occasional repeated leading tokens in decode. 2) container/runtime mismatch: image was built with CUDA 12.3 + Triton 2.20, but the infra nodes are running CUDA 12.2 and Triton 2.19. Do we need a full container rebuild to target 12.2, or is kernel fallback safe for initial rollout? cc @Raj :wave

Raj: @Maria short answer: probably rebuild if we see missing symbols at load time. Minor CUDA dot releases can add cublasLt symbols that kernels depend on. But do a quick smoke first — run the model container on a CUDA12.2 node and check for PTX / symbol errors. If it's just warnings we can fallback.

Maria: here's the quick smoke command I ran locally on my laptop (linux box not infra):

```
# run triton container with mounted model repo
docker run --rm -v /mnt/models/solace-13b:/models nvcr.io/nvidia/tritonserver:23.08-py3 \
  tritonserver --model-repository=/models --strict-model-config=false
```

Log snippet I got (on laptop):
```
[2026-02-10 14:12:21.123] [E] CUDA: symbol lookup error: /opt/triton/backends/.../libfastattn.so: undefined symbol: cublasLtMatmulDescInitV2
```

Oliver: That undefined symbol often means the kernel was compiled against a newer cuBLAS/RC, yep. There is an env we sometimes use for quick fallbacks: `KERNEL_COMPAT_MODE=ptx-compat` — it forces PTX JIT paths and may avoid the direct symbol, but perf will be worse.

Sophie: On the tokenizer side — can you paste the first 10 token ids and sample decode? If model was trained without a BOS, we can either remap the tokenizer to not emit BOS or set `bos_token_id` to `null` in model_config. Quick fix: update tokenizer config to `{"bos_token_id": null, "add_prefix_space": true}` and re-run tokenization.

ci-bot: CI job 4521 alerted: model-tests/solace-13b on ubuntu-22 cuda12.2 failed to load custom kernel libfastattn.so (exit code 127). See https://ci.redwood/4521 for logs.

deploy-bot: Suggestion: schedule `container-rebuild:solace-13b` if any runtime node reports missing cuBLAS symbol. Automated job will build against CUDA 12.2 toolchain and push image tag `solace-13b:cuda12.2-triton2.19`.

Raj: If rebuild can't happen same-day, fallback approach: 1) set `KERNEL_COMPAT_MODE=ptx-compat` and `TRITON_ALLOW_LOWER_KERNELS=1` (these envs are supported in our runtime) 2) update model_config to enable slower but safe kernels. This will buy us time but expect ~2-3x token latency. Also we should capture `ldd` of libfastattn.so on infra node to double-check which symbols are unresolved.

Maria: Dockerfile base we used: `FROM nvcr.io/nvidia/tritonserver:23.08-py3` — nvidia-smi on infra shows CUDA Version: 12.2, Driver: 535.54.7. Triton on node reports 2.19.0. The laptop that built the container had CUDA 12.3 and triton 2.20. Small log paste from infra node when I tried to load the image: `error: undefined symbol: cublasLtMatmulDescInitV2`

Oliver: That symbol was introduced in the cuBLASLt API around 12.3 (IIRC). Best path: rebuild kernels against 12.2 or vendor a fallback kernel variant compiled without that symbol. I'll try a quick recompile of libfastattn with CUDA 12.2 on infra-rt-03 and post results.

Sophie: I'll prep tokenizer patch: remove emitting BOS, set `bos_token_id: null`, and add a short unit test. Will open PR shortly and tag infra + @Maria.

Raj: Also remind to pin `GCC` toolchain in the build container — ABI mismatches sometimes show up as similar undefined symbols. For the rebuild job, set `TARGET_CUDA=12.2` and `TRITON_VERSION=2.19.0` so we produce a compatible image.

Maria: Can someone try smoke on node infra-rt-03? If it loads (even slow) we can proceed with soft rollout and rollback plan. Tagging @Oliver @Raj. :pray:

Oliver: On it. Running smoke now against infra-rt-03 (CUDA12.2). Will post logs in ~10m.

[~10m later]

Oliver: Smoke result: model loads, kernel fallback engaged, warnings about slower kernels, but no undefined symbol crash after setting `KERNEL_COMPAT_MODE=ptx-compat`. Perf is degraded (generation ~2.4x slower) — logs: `WARN kernel_selection: falling back to PTX JIT path for attention kernel`. No OOMs.

Maria: Good find. Sophie — if your tokenizer PR lands we can avoid some decode jitter. Raj/Oliver — can infra queue a rebuild job for tonight? If rebuild succeeds we swap image in staging and compare perf.

Sophie: PR opened: github.com/redwood/models/pull/834 — includes tokenizer change and test. cc infra team.

Raj: I'll kick off container-rebuild:solace-13b (target cuda12.2) and set `canary=true` so it goes to staging infra first. Will post job id.

deploy-bot: Rebuild job scheduled: job-7782 (target: cuda12.2, triton:2.19). ETA ~45m. Notifying staging cluster for canary deploy.

Maria: Thanks everyone. I'll hold the public rollout until canary perf checks pass. :thumbsup:

Oliver: If canary looks good I'll help flip the image and run the regression suite.

Maria: Awesome — will follow up after job-7782 completes.
